<description>
Add the two new test vectors from:

- https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2275
- https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/1971

https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2275 additionally requires _existing_ `Combine` vectors to run in both orders, so we do that here too.
</description>

<commits>
029bc15f2c test: add BIP174 sighash combiner vector

Test both input orders per bitcoin/bips#2275.

6fa2f3974c test: add BIP174 invalid value size vector

From bitcoin/bips#1971.
</commits>
